svg.title: Fulfillment status and merchant closure
svg.desc: A paid order in progress can be delivered or shipped. Refusal or a missed deadline leaves it unfulfilled, and late delivery is still accepted until the merchant closes fulfillment. The merchant can close an order that has not been delivered or shipped. Closure preserves the original payment fact and blocks future Agentify fulfillment. An unknown payment remains payment_unresolved until its original outcome is established, even when merchant closure is recorded.
